biotools.summary: AgrOmicSo is a client-server platform that automates large-scale Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) data analysis. It provides a user-friendly Graphical User Interface (GUI) for running complex genomic pipelines, including quality control, read mapping, and variant calling, on remote servers.
biotools.name: AgrOmicSo: Accessible NGS Data Analysis Interface
